svg.title: The region used to compare the infinite field with one finite stage
svg.desc: On the q axis, zero precedes 1 over 2 a J, which precedes 1 over a J and q zero. Every cutoff with index at most J equals one in the first region. The tail in that region is bounded by 2 to the minus J times q to the power g J plus 1 over 2 minus the fixed derivative loss.

g.text: Compare with one fixed finite stage J
Schematic positions; the endpoint formulas and interval relations are exact.
All cutoffs j ≤ J equal one
In the green region: U − U^[J] = the tail with j > J.
Its derivatives obey (S4.4); the complete nonlinear residual obeys (S5.2)–(S5.8).
Fix derivative order and desired decay → choose J → shrink the q-neighborhood.
